headline: LEGENDARY 🏆 Stephanie Cole DIES 💀 Aged 84 After ALZHEIMER'S 🧠 Battle
text:
ACTRESS 🎭 Stephanie Cole from TENKO 🪖 and CORONATION 🛍️ STREET has sadly DIED 😢 at the age of EIGHTY FOUR 8️⃣4️⃣ after living with ALZHEIMER'S 🧠 for several YEARS 📅 her agent John Grant dropped the HEARTBREAKING 💔 statement on behalf of her FAMILY 👨‍👩‍👧 confirming the news that rocked the INDUSTRY 🎥!! "Stephanie was an EXTRAORDINARY 🌟 talent whose LONG 📏 and distinguished CAREER 🏆 included many ICONIC 🏛️ performances in THEATRE 🎭 and television" the statement READ 📖 as everyone MOURNED 🕯️ the loss of a true QUEEN 👑 who brought JOY 😂 to MILLIONS 📈 through her much loved ROLES 🎬 in sitcoms and DRAMA 📺 she will ALSO 🔀 be remembered for her TIRELESS 💪 work supporting MENTAL 🧠 health CHARITIES ❤️!!

Solihull BORN 🏠 Cole who trained at BRISTOL 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 Old Vic Theatre SCHOOL 🏫 after making her STAGE 🎤 debut at the age of SEVENTEEN 1️⃣7️⃣ playing the NINETY 9️⃣0️⃣ year old MEDIUM 🔮 Madame Arcati in Noel Coward's BLITHE 👻 Spirit went on to enjoy a LENGTHY ⏳ career that SPANNED 🌉 TV 📺 radio 📻 and FILM 🎞️ and was perhaps BEST 🏅 known for playing Dr Beatrice Mason in the 1980s BBC WARTIME ⚔️ TV drama TENKO 🏕️ the series CHRONICLED 📜 the lives of British WOMEN 👩 in Singapore after the JAPANESE 🇯🇵 invasion and their consequent CONFINEMENT ⛓️ in a Japanese prisoner of WAR 🪖 camp Cole in her BREAKOUT 🚀 role played a doctor who STRUGGLED 😣 to look after the women's HEALTH 🩹 opposite Ann Bell and Claire Oberman during this SAME ⏰ period Cole also played the moody CUSTOMER 🛒 Mrs Delphine Featherstone aka The BLACK 🖤 Widow in the Ronnie Barker starring OPEN 🛍️ All Hours she would go on to WIN 🏆 the award for best TV COMEDY 😂 actress for her part as the sharp tongued PHOTOJOURNALIST 📸 Diana Trent in Waiting For God but she cited her earlier PERFORMANCE 🎭 as Muriel in Alan Bennett's monologue Soldiering On as one of her PROUDEST 🏅 moments the series also starred Maggie Smith and Julie Walters her STAGE 🎭 highlight by her account was in a West End production of A Passionate WOMAN 👩!!

Cole also PLAYED 🎭 Roy Cropper's mother in ITV soap CORONATION 🛍️ Street for two YEARS 📅 from 2011 and she REPRISED 🔄 her earlier role in the 2010s REBOOT 🔄 Still Open All Hours opposite David Jason plus she appeared alongside Suranne Jones in Gentleman JACK 🧥 Cole was made an OBE 🏅 at Buckingham Palace in 2005 for her services to DRAMA 🎭 the elderly and mental health CHARITIES ❤️ her other notable ROLES 🎬 included Keeping Mum and the BBC Radio 4 sitcom Cabin Pressure alongside a fast rising Benedict Cumberbatch as Carolyn Knapp Shappey "One of the JOYS 😊 of my character was how STRONG 💪 and feisty she is she had the UPPER 🖐️ hand over the men for the most part" she told the Guardian in 2018 "Carolyn told it like it WAS 📢 and took no rubbish we've all met women like her she was very easy to put on and I confess perhaps there's a little of her BOSSINESS 😤 in me" she also appeared in Coronation Street as Roy Cropper's mother Sylvia Goodwin which won her another COMEDY 😂 prize in her 70s at the 2012 British Soap AWARDS 🏆!!

On HALLOWEEN 🎃 2018 she also guest starred in the live episode of Reece Shearsmith and Steve Pemberton's Inside No.9 titled Dead LINE 📏 Cole appeared opposite Ronnie Barker as the moody customer Mrs Delphine Featherstone in the 1980s and her STAGE 🎭 work included Driving Miss Daisy Noises Off and King Lear in 2004 she returned to her debut theatre ROLE 🎭 in Blithe Spirit aged SIXTY THREE 6️⃣3️⃣ when the play was revived at the West End's Savoy Theatre she also appeared in Midsomer Murders and Doctors her LAST 🏁 major TV role was appearing opposite Greg Davies in his BBC comedy series The Cleaner in 2021 Cole was married TWICE 💍 first to playwright and theatrical fight director Henry Marshall whom she divorced in 1988 a decade later she married fellow actor Peter Birrel thirty YEARS 📅 after the pair first appeared together in a production of Richard II at the Bristol Old Vic Birrel died in 2004 Cole is survived by a daughter from her first marriage Emma Battcock what a LEGEND 🏆 what a LIFE 🧬 bro she was built DIFFERENT 🦸‍♀️!!
